notes: Neon Man delivers a fast-paced, curious hook on 'No UPI Day' protest, transitions into the visual shock of QR codes covered in black cloth over MDR charges, expands to Maharashtra joining on Gandhi Jayanti, and closes on consumer cash requirement. Directions below are creative recommendations for our narrator.

segments.speaker: reference narrator
